mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, reducing revenue expectations for S&P 500 constituents and producing negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling RSAFS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, raising discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS crosses above 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% combined with a 3-month decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a synchronized labor market weakening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of both rising UNRATE above 4.5% and falling PAYEMS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 1.0% signals weakening manufacturing output, reducing earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO falls below 1.0% growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad weakening in demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of both falling RSAFS and HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% combined with a 3-month decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a synchronized labor market weakening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of both rising UNRATE above 4.5% and falling PAYEMS (t-test p > 0.05).
